info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Consumer Service Consumer Advisory Service-spec
info.description: The Consumer Advisory Service API enables businesses to initiate the process of creating consumer advisory services tailored for their clientele. This API facilitates interactions that help organizations manage consumer needs effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions and advisory service providers looking to enhance their customer engagement through personalized services. By leveraging this API, users can streamline the creation and integration of advisory solutions to improve overall consumer satisfaction and ensure compliance with industry standards.

post.summary: Create a new consumer advisory service.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a new consumer advisory service, enabling consumers to receive tailored advice based on their specific needs and inquiries. This service is designed to enhance the consumer experience and provide valuable insights.
